atracdenc - ATRAC encoder (ATRAC1 / ATRAC3) by Daniil Cherednik, LGPL-2.1.
https://github.com/dcherednik/atracdenc
atracdenc.js here is a WebAssembly build of it (GPL-2.0).
MiniDisc Manager uses it only to encode LP2 and LP4 tracks for standard MiniDiscs (see helper\atrac3_encode.js).
This build rounds the requested bitrate up to the next supported frame size, so the app asks for 128 (LP2, 384-byte frames)
and 64 (LP4, 192-byte frames); both were checked by decoding the result with ffmpeg.
